label: H.R. 6505

Read twice and referred to the Committee on Commerce, Science, and Transportation.

selection.reason: Impact scored and summarised by Gemini.

summary: H.R. 6505, the Next Generation 9-1-1 Act, establishes a federal grant program to help state, territorial, and tribal governments upgrade their emergency dispatch facilities to secure, internet-protocol-based Next Generation 9-1-1 (NG9-1-1) systems. It also creates a nationwide cybersecurity center and an advisory board to support the rollout of these advanced technologies.

affected_groups.effect: Eligible to apply for grants, required to designate points of contact, submit implementation plans, and maintain sustainable funding and cybersecurity mechanisms.
Can receive updated NG9-1-1 technology to process text, pictures, multimedia, and location data, and participate in governance and advisory boards.
Gains access to improved emergency response communications that support enhanced location-finding, text messaging, and multimedia transmission to 9-1-1.

key_provisions: Establishes a grant program through the National Telecommunications and Information Administration (NTIA) to help eligible entities implement and maintain NG9-1-1 systems.
Requires grant applicants to submit implementation plans detailing interoperability, reliability, cybersecurity measures, open procurement processes, and stakeholder coordination.
Prohibits grant recipients from using 9-1-1 fees for unauthorized purposes and requires them to establish sustainable funding mechanisms and cybersecurity resources within three years.
Establishes a nationwide Next Generation 9-1-1 Cybersecurity Center in consultation with the Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency to share threat info and security guidelines.
Creates a Public Safety Next Generation 9-1-1 Advisory Board composed of 16 public safety members to provide recommendations on deployment, rules, and grant criteria.
Authorizes the appropriation of such sums as may be necessary for fiscal years 2026 through 2030 to carry out these activities.
missing_information: The specific dollar amounts authorized to be appropriated for fiscal years 2026 through 2030 are not specified in the text (the bill states 'such sums as may be necessary').
summary_detail.plain_summary: H.R. 6505, the Next Generation 9-1-1 Act, establishes a federal grant program to help state, territorial, and tribal governments upgrade their emergency dispatch facilities to secure, internet-protocol-based Next Generation 9-1-1 (NG9-1-1) systems. It also creates a nationwide cybersecurity center and an advisory board to support the rollout of these advanced technologies.
summary_detail.significance: The bill establishes a structured federal grant program, cybersecurity coordination, and advisory oversight to transition the nation's emergency dispatch networks from legacy telephone systems to modern internet-protocol-based infrastructure. The legislation creates specific accountability requirements, including strict penalties for misusing local 9-1-1 fees and false certifications, while authorizing appropriations through fiscal year 2030.
